summary.name: Coursera
summary.one_liner: Coursera is an online learning platform offering courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees from universities and companies such as Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford.
use_cases: Build job-ready skills for a new career
Learn AI tools and workflows for your field
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees from more than 350 leading universities and companies. It highlights AI-focused courses organized by field and career goals, and says no prior experience is needed to start. It cites a figure that 91% of learners reported a positive career outcome, including new job opportunities, increased knowledge, and improved work performance. Salary and job-opening data is attributed to the Lightcast Job Postings Report with stated date ranges. The page text itself does not describe specific course formats, pricing, or enrollment steps.
notable: Courses from 350+ universities and companies, including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford
Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees in one catalog
AI-focused learning paths organized by career field
Reports 91% positive career outcome among learners (page claim)
caveats: Pricing and free-versus-paid access are not stated on the page text
The 91% career outcome figure is a self-reported marketing claim
Salary and job data footnote covers different date ranges per role
